name: Spirit of the Wind
summary: At Camp Taurajo, Mangletooth offers travelers a burst of speed drawn from Agamaggan's blood shards. The captive quilboar's ritual helps them cross the Barrens swiftly.

sections.title: A Gift from Blood Shards
sections.body: Crossing the Barrens quickly can help you avoid its beasts and centaur warbands. At Camp Taurajo, the captive quilboar Mangletooth draws on red crystalline blood shards scattered across the region. Give him ten, and he channels their lingering power into a burst of swiftness called the Spirit of the Wind.

sections.title: Agamaggan's Ancient Breath
sections.body: Quilboar honor Agamaggan, the Great Boar whose blood was spilled across central Kalimdor during the ancient War of the Ancients. Mangletooth knows the rites that channel that spilled blood, even in captivity. The ritual stirs wild vigor, lending a runner speed to match the zhevra herds. Though quilboar are bitter enemies of the Horde, Mangletooth shares Agamaggan's boons with travelers who bring him fresh shards.

faq.q: What is the Spirit of the Wind?
aliases: what is spirit of the wind
faq.answer: The Spirit of the Wind is a brief blessing Mangletooth grants at Camp Taurajo. For ten blood shards, he lends travelers speed to cross the Barrens.

faq.q: Who offers the Spirit of the Wind?
aliases: who gives spirit of the wind
who turns in blood shards for speed
faq.answer: Mangletooth offers the blessing. He is a quilboar held prisoner by the Horde at Camp Taurajo, and performs the ritual when you earn his cooperation.

faq.q: Why does Mangletooth require blood shards?
aliases: what does mangletooth do with shards
faq.answer: Blood shards are crystalline fragments of Agamaggan's spilled blood. Mangletooth draws on the ancient demi-god's primal power within them to weave his boons.

faq.q: Can I receive this blessing more than once?
aliases: is spirit of the wind repeatable
can i do this quest again
faq.answer: Yes. Bring Mangletooth ten blood shards each time, and he can channel the blessing whenever you return.

faq.q: Why would a quilboar help members of the Horde?
faq.answer: Mangletooth is captive in Taurajo. He bargains his ancestral knowledge of Agamaggan's magic to secure his survival, dealing with travelers who gather the sacred shards he values.

faq.q: How long does the blessing last?
faq.answer: The blessing fades before long, but Mangletooth's enchantment lends enough swiftness to ease travel across the Barrens for a time.

angles.text: At Camp Taurajo, guards watch Mangletooth closely. Horde scouts use his knowledge of blood shard magic to cross the southern plains faster.
As a druid, you may find the lingering power of the Wild God Agamaggan in these rites a fascinating, raw expression of primeval nature.
As a shaman, you may hear an echo of your traditions in communing with the wind through crystallized divine essence, with its reverence for elemental and ancestral forces.
